August 25

12 Take heed, brethren, lest there be in any of you an evil heart of unbelief, in departing from the living God. (Hebrews 3:12 KJV)

It is one of Satan’s main inroads into the believer, and he is a master at trying to make one feel unworthy and condemned. The devil loves to put it into your conscience that God won’t heal you or help you in time of need, because you are just not worthy of His help. The churches commonly teach that also, as they like to make you feel unworthy and that you need to do a lot of works for the Lord to be blessed by Him. Remember, your born again spirit is created in Holiness and Righteousness (Ephesians 4:24), and your relationship with God is by your spirit, and not by your actions, for God is a spirit (John 4:24). Praise God for His mercy.
